title: Senior Software Engineer - 10+ yrs (Python, Django and LLM)
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job About the job About DoctusTech DoctusTech is a fast\-growing technology company focused on driving innovation in the US Healthcare domain. We build impactful AI\-driven solutions that solve real\-world problems for our clients. Our team is agile, collaborative, and passionate about technology, and we're looking for strong engineering leaders who thrive in a high\-ownership environment. Job Summary We are looking for a highly experienced Sr. Software Engineer with 10\+ years of hands\-on backend engineering experience in Python ecosystems. This is role focused on architecture, hands\-on coding, scalability, and building next\-generation AI\-powered systems. The ideal candidate must have strong expertise in Python, Django, FastAPI, distributed backend systems, and Agentic AI/LLM\-based application development. You will work closely with product and engineering teams to design, develop, and scale intelligent healthcare solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and scale high\-performance backend systems using Python, Django, and FastAPI. Build secure, scalable, and production\-grade RESTful APIs and microservices. Lead architecture decisions and implement complex technical solutions. Develop AI\-powered applications leveraging Agentic AI, LLMs, RAG pipelines, and orchestration frameworks. Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and testable production\-quality code. Optimize application performance, reliability, scalability, and security. Mentor engineering teams through technical leadership and best coding practices. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams in an agile development environment. Drive innovation and evaluate emerging AI technologies/frameworks. Participate in code reviews, debugging, and system design discussions. Required Skills
   

  

* 10\+ years of software development experience.
* Strong hands\-on coding expertise in Python.
* Deep expertise in Django and FastAPI.
* Experience building scalable backend architectures and REST APIs.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems and microservices architecture.
* Hands\-on experience with Agentic AI, Generative AI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar frameworks.
* Strong understanding of AI orchestration and prompt engineering concepts.
* Expertise with PostgreSQL/MySQL and database optimization.
* Strong knowledge of Django ORM, SQL queries, and performance tuning.
* Experience with cloud platforms and deployment practices.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Deep understanding of system design, design patterns, data structures, and OOP concepts.
* Familiarity with Linux environments and DevOps fundamentals. Preferred Qualifications
* Experience in US Healthcare domain, EHR/EMR, HL7, or FHIR integrations is a plus.
* Experience working in high\-scale SaaS product companies.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Candidate Requirements
* Own laptop/system (minimum 8GB RAM and i5 processor or above)
* Stable internet connectivity/Wi\-Fi
* Power backup during outages


**Required Skills**
 \['Python Django Python /Django Python/Django/Flask Django\-Rest\-Framework Python(Django', 'Flask', 'FastAPI)']
